mapper.select: SELECT tdm01_person_id AS person_id , tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , tdm01_pos_nm AS pos_name , tdm01_org_nm AS org_name FROM ( SELECT * , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , tdm01_pos_cd , tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_pos_nm , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', tdm01_title_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_title_nm FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(tdm01_retire_date,'9999-12-31'::date) > f_today() AND COALESCE(tdm01_end_date ,'9999-12-31'::date) > f_today() ) t WHERE 1=1 AND CONCAT(tdm01_person_nm, tdm01_pos_nm, tdm01_org_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm01_pos_cd, tdm01_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

WITH emp AS ( SELECT * FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, f_today()) WHERE ( COALESCE(emp00_tdm_target_yn,'false') = 'true' OR ( COALESCE(emp00_tdm_target_yn,'false') != 'true' AND emp00_retire_date IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = emp00_company_id AND tdm01_person_id = emp00_person_id AND COALESCE(tdm01_retire_date, '1999-01-01') != emp00_retire_date ) ) ) AND emp00_trans_cd != '800' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id ) /* 겸직제외 */ ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm01_change_type_cd , tdm01_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" ) AS hr_id , t.tdm01_change_type_cd AS change_type_code, t.tdm01_change_type_nm AS change_type_name , t.tdm01_person_id AS person_id, t.tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , t.tdm01_bef_pos_nm AS bef_pos_name, t.tdm01_bef_title_nm AS bef_title_name, t.tdm01_bef_org_nm AS bef_org_name , t.tdm01_bef_hire_date AS bef_hire_date, t.tdm01_bef_retire_date AS bef_retire_date, t.tdm01_bef_end_date AS bef_end_date , t.tdm01_aft_pos_nm AS aft_pos_name, t.tdm01_aft_title_nm AS aft_title_name, t.tdm01_aft_org_nm AS aft_org_name , t.tdm01_aft_hire_date AS aft_hire_date, t.tdm01_aft_retire_date AS aft_retire_date, t.tdm01_aft_end_date AS aft_end_date FROM ( -------------------------------------- -- 신규 -------------------------------------- SELECT '1' AS tdm01_change_type_cd , '신규' AS tdm01_change_type_nm , emp00_person_id AS tdm01_person_id , emp00_kor_nm AS tdm01_person_nm , null AS tdm01_bef_pos_nm , null AS tdm01_bef_title_nm , null AS tdm01_bef_org_nm , null AS tdm01_bef_hire_date , null AS tdm01_bef_retire_date , null AS tdm01_bef_end_date , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , emp00_pos_cd , emp00_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_aft_pos_nm , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp00_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_aft_title_nm , emp00_org_code_nm AS tdm01_aft_org_nm , emp00_hire_date AS tdm01_aft_hire_date , emp00_retire_date AS tdm01_aft_retire_date , null AS tdm01_aft_end_date FROM emp WHERE emp00_person_id IN ( SELECT emp00_person_id FROM emp WHERE COALESCE(emp00_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > f_today() EXCEPT SELECT tdm01_person_id FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = #{companyId} ) -------------------------------------- -- 제외 (퇴사가 아닌데, 책무대상에서 빠진 경우) -------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT '3' AS tdm01_change_type_cd , '제외' AS tdm01_change_type_nm , tdm01_person_id AS tdm01_person_id , tdm01_person_nm AS tdm01_person_nm , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , tdm01_pos_cd , tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_bef_pos_nm , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', tdm01_title_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_bef_title_nm , tdm01_org_nm AS tdm01_bef_org_nm , tdm01_hire_date AS tdm01_bef_hire_date , tdm01_retire_date AS tdm01_bef_retire_date , tdm01_end_date AS tdm01_bef_end_date , null AS tdm01_aft_pos_nm , null AS tdm01_aft_title_nm , null AS tdm01_aft_org_nm , null AS tdm01_aft_hire_date , null AS tdm01_aft_retire_date , null AS tdm01_aft_end_date FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm01_person_id IN ( SELECT tdm01_person_id FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm01_end_date IS NULL EXCEPT SELECT emp00_person_id FROM emp ) -------------------------------------- -- 변동 -------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT '2' AS tdm01_change_type_cd , '변동' AS tdm01_change_type_nm , tdm01_person_id AS tdm01_person_id , tdm01_person_nm AS tdm01_person_nm , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , tdm01_pos_cd , tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_bef_pos_nm , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', tdm01_title_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_bef_title_nm , tdm01_org_nm AS tdm01_bef_org_nm , tdm01_hire_date AS tdm01_bef_hire_date , tdm01_retire_date AS tdm01_bef_retire_date , tdm01_end_date AS tdm01_bef_end_date , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , emp00_pos_cd , tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_aft_pos_nm , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm01_aft_title_nm , emp00_org_code_nm AS tdm01_aft_org_nm , emp00_hire_date AS tdm01_aft_hire_date , emp00_retire_date AS tdm01_aft_retire_date , null AS tdm01_aft_end_date FROM tdm01_hr INNER JOIN emp ON emp00_person_id = tdm01_person_id WHERE tdm01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( tdm01_person_nm != emp00_kor_nm OR tdm01_pos_cd != emp00_pos_cd OR tdm01_title_cd != emp00_title_cd OR tdm01_org_id != emp00_org_code_id OR tdm01_org_nm != emp00_org_code_nm OR tdm01_hire_date != emp00_hire_date OR COALESCE(tdm01_retire_date,'9999-12-31') != emp00_retire_date OR tdm01_end_date IS NOT NULL ) ) t

SELECT emp00_person_id AS person_id , emp00_kor_nm AS kor_name , emp00_emp_no AS emp_no , emp00_pos_cd AS pos_code , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , emp00_pos_cd , emp00_company_id, f_today()) AS pos_name , emp00_title_cd AS title_code , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp00_company_id, f_today()) AS title_name , emp00_hire_date AS hire_date , emp00_retire_date AS retire_date , emp00_trans_date AS trans_date , emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id , emp00_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , emp00_org_head_nm AS org_head_name FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, f_today()) WHERE emp00_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT tdm01_person_id AS person_id , tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , tdm01_pos_cd AS pos_code , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode' , tdm01_pos_cd , tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS pos_name , tdm01_title_cd AS title_code , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', tdm01_title_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today()) AS title_name , tdm01_hire_date AS hire_date , tdm01_retire_date AS retire_date , tdm01_end_date AS end_date , tdm01_org_id AS org_id , tdm01_org_nm AS org_name FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_person_id = #{personId}
